body:
**MMR-18 progress (Claude, attempt 2): generated campaign boots, two worlds isolated. Not complete: c1 still unmet.**

Fixes since Astra's checkpoint:
1. Live defaults now gather all ten kinds (`SiegeEngineType`, `SkeletonScale` added). The IL shows both load before `RegisterSubModuleObjects`, and every kind must contribute at least one ready object.
2. Census crash: `CampaignObjectManager.Settlements` stays null until `InitializeOnNewGame`, and `Rows(null)` threw an unhandled `InvalidOperationException` inside `OnCampaignStart` (PID 8152). Lists are now captured per-list as available/unavailable. Generated engine callbacks now trace exceptions before rethrowing.
3. `BodyGeneratorView..ctor` dereferences `facgen_template_test_char_0..9` without a null check (PID 33184). A Cecil scan of installed IL found 142 hard-coded character IDs. 33 reusable, non-hero ones are now explicit dataset roots (`Options.EngineCharacterIds`). `fighter_sturgia` is excluded because the stock record has a dangling roster. Official heroes are excluded. Evidence: `build/research-bootstrap18/engine-character-literals.json`.
4. The catalog receipt paths resolved only inside the Codex MSIX package cache, so the catalog was copied to the real AppData path. All 24 hashes match.

Runtime: PID 19700 (one world) and PID 31308 (seed 42 → normal EndGame → seed 43) both finished `status=ok` with zero validation failures, no save changes, and normal exit. Summary: `evidence/runtime/bootstrap-probe.json`. Offline harness: 60 managed checks, real-catalog preflight, and both descriptors pass.

Criteria: c2 met, c3 met (with caveats in the summary). **c1 is unmet:** only paused MapState has been reached. Time advancement, recruitment, and trade have not been exercised. Town meshes don't render (nameplates only). Save reconstruction is still NotSupported.
